scope: Train-only descriptive support of frozen V13 IF tail versus existing label-onset weights. Expanding historical training populations overlap; do not sum these rows as independent examples.
fixed_q95_definition: Previously frozen V13 linear q95 of ALL finite known-normal training original IF scores; verified against stored fitted mask.
label_reconstruction: Known-positive original segment intervals and onset eligibility from fitted training audits only. Other labels not inferred or filled. All counts use stored training eligibility.
support_limit: Tail rows are a train-only detector-evidence proxy, not actual V6 calibrated reference pulse labels. No candidate anchor/window variant was selected or evaluated here.
